text:
alice: Heads-up: nightly deploy 02:30 UTC. We'll be unwinding the convo-cache gate in staged cohorts. Preflight checklist below — ping if blocked.

sam: Which cohorts first — internal or 1%?

alice: Start internal -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. 30m window between each step. If p50 latency up >20% or error rate +>1% hold and revert.

jordan: Can deploybot auto-pause on error-rate spike (5m avg >1%)?

alice: Yes — deploybot policy: pause-and-alert if error_rate_5m > 1%. Auto-route fallback to model v1.2.

deploybot: ACK schedule: convo-cache toggle: internal now. Command queued: `/deploybot ff-toggle convo-cache --target=internal --initiator=alice --runbook=https://go/runbooks/convo-cache-unwind`

kim: I'll watch tracing and the perf dash. If kv-cache miss rate >10% or disk IO >80% I'll call revert.

sam: Should we pin the user route to model v1.3 for cohorts >=25%? avoids any model skew during bigger rollout.

alice: Yes, pin user-route -> v1.3 at 25% and 100%. Keep canary traffic on v1.2 for comparison.

jordan: Oncall window 02:15-03:30 UTC. I'll jump if anything looks off.

deploybot: Toggle complete: convo-cache -> internal (ts: 6372000040). Next action scheduled +10m for 1% cohort. Monitoring hooks attached.

alice: Rollback commands if we need to abort: `/deploybot ff-toggle convo-cache --target=0% --reason="latency spike"` and open incident. Also run: `pin-route --route=user --version=v1.2` if needed.

sam: Copy. Preparing rollback doc and quick links: https://go/ops/rollbacks/convo-cache-unwind

kim: Quick debug tip: `tail -f /var/log/prod/cache.log | grep convo-cache` and check `trace:convo-cache` span heatmap.

jordan: :thumbsup: all set. I'll monitor disk IO and p95.

alice: Thanks team — will post updates at each cohort step. If anyone needs escalation call me directly.
